hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-${PWD:-.}}}"; d="$(cd "$d" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || exit 0; while [ -n "$d" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do if [ -f "$d/harness/.wtc-cli-version" ]; then cd "$d" || exit 0; if command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then mise exec -- wtc agent-env --write && exit 0; fi; if command -v wtc >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec wtc agent-env --write; fi; exit 0; fi; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; exit 0
